title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals interferon-stimulated epithelial states in COPD exacerbations
abstract: scRNA-seq of airway brushings identifies IFN-high epithelial programs linked to viral signatures and worse FEV1; suggests JAK-STAT modulation as a target.
journal: American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine

title: Neutralizing antibodies to SARS-CoV-2 XBB lineages after bivalent mRNA boosting
abstract: Serum neutralization against XBB.1.5 and related variants increases after bivalent boosters but wanes by 4 months; prior infection broadens responses.

title: Long-read assembly of the human Y chromosome resolves ampliconic regions and structural variation
abstract: Using PacBio HiFi and ONT ultra-long reads, authors assemble telomere-to-telomere Y haplotypes and map recurrent ampliconic rearrangements.

title: Guidelines for reporting machine learning in biomedical research: a consensus statement
abstract: Consensus recommendations cover dataset curation, leakage checks, model evaluation, calibration, external validation, and transparency of code and data.

title: CRISPR-based diagnostics for infectious disease: current status and future directions
abstract: Review of SHERLOCK, DETECTR and Cas13/Cas12 platforms, sample prep, analytical sensitivity, and deployment constraints in low-resource settings.

title: Safety and immunogenicity of an RSV prefusion F vaccine in older adults: a phase 3 trial
abstract: Randomized trial in adults ≥60 shows robust neutralizing titers and reduced medically attended RSV-associated lower respiratory disease; reactogenicity mild.

title: Integrating polygenic scores into cardiovascular risk prediction in primary care
abstract: Prospective evaluation shows polygenic scores modestly improve reclassification for coronary events when added to conventional risk factors; utility varies by ancestry.

title: A randomized trial of intensive blood pressure control in chronic kidney disease
abstract: Compared with standard targets, intensive systolic BP control reduced composite cardiovascular outcomes but increased episodes of AKI and electrolyte disturbances.

title: Single-cell atlas of human pancreatic islets across type 2 diabetes progression
abstract: Atlas of endocrine and immune populations highlights stress-response beta-cell states and macrophage polarization associated with glycemic control.

title: Microplastics in human blood: detection and characterization by pyrolysis-GC/MS
abstract: Reports polymer fragments in whole blood samples; discusses contamination control and limitations in quantification and clinical interpretation.

title: Immunogenicity and effectiveness of fourth-dose COVID-19 vaccination in healthcare workers
abstract: Observational cohort shows increased anti-spike IgG and modest protection against symptomatic infection during Omicron; effectiveness against severe disease preserved.

title: Antibiotic resistance genes in urban wastewater: global patterns from metagenomic surveillance
abstract: Metagenomes from 60 cities show regional ARG profiles correlated with antibiotic consumption and sanitation metrics; supports wastewater as AMR early warning.

title: Clinical outcomes of molnupiravir in nonhospitalized adults with COVID-19: interim analysis
abstract: Interim analysis suggests reduced hospitalization or death versus placebo in high-risk outpatients; discusses variant context and adverse event profile.
journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

title: Deep learning for detection of diabetic retinopathy in primary care: external validation study
abstract: Model trained on fundus photos maintains AUROC >0.9 across three health systems; performance drops in low-quality images, highlighting QA needs.

title: Gut microbiome signatures associated with response to immune checkpoint blockade across cancers
abstract: Meta-analysis identifies taxa and functional pathways linked to ICI response; antibiotic exposure and sequencing batch effects are major confounders.

title: Heterologous prime-boost COVID-19 vaccination with ChAdOx1 and BNT162b2: immune responses and reactogenicity
abstract: Heterologous schedule elicits higher neutralizing titers and T-cell responses than homologous ChAdOx1; transient systemic reactions more frequent after boost.

title: Real-world effectiveness of BNT162b2 mRNA vaccination against SARS-CoV-2 infection in Israel
abstract: Nationwide cohort shows high effectiveness against infection and severe disease shortly after rollout; estimates vary by age and time since dose.

title: WHO Solidarity trial of remdesivir and other repurposed antivirals for COVID-19
abstract: Large multinational trial finds little or no effect of remdesivir, hydroxychloroquine, lopinavir, or interferon on overall mortality among hospitalized patients.
journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

title: mRNA-1273 SARS-CoV-2 vaccine in adults: final efficacy and safety results
abstract: Final analysis confirms high efficacy against symptomatic COVID-19 with acceptable safety; includes subgroup analyses by age and comorbidities.
journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

title: SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody responses in convalescent individuals and vaccine recipients
abstract: Characterizes breadth and potency of neutralizing antibodies and correlates with time since symptom onset; discusses implications for vaccine design.

title: Dexamethasone in hospitalized patients with Covid-19
abstract: In RECOVERY, dexamethasone reduced 28-day mortality in patients receiving oxygen or ventilation; no benefit in those not requiring respiratory support.

title: Remdesivir for the treatment of Covid-19 — final report
abstract: ACTT-1 trial reports shorter time to recovery with remdesivir compared with placebo in hospitalized adults; mortality difference not statistically significant.

title: Hydroxychloroquine with or without azithromycin in mild-to-moderate Covid-19
abstract: Randomized trial finds no clinical benefit of hydroxychloroquine, with or without azithromycin; QT prolongation and adverse events were more common.

title: A trial of lopinavir-ritonavir in adults hospitalized with severe Covid-19
abstract: Open-label randomized trial shows no significant difference in time to clinical improvement; gastrointestinal adverse events were frequent.

title: Clinical course and risk factors for mortality of adult inpatients with COVID-19 in Wuhan, China: a retrospective cohort study
abstract: Among hospitalized adults, older age, high SOFA score and d-dimer >1 μg/mL were associated with in-hospital death; highlights multi-organ dysfunction.

title: Deep learning to identify arrhythmia from a large outpatient ECG dataset
abstract: Neural network trained on single-lead ECGs detects multiple rhythm classes with cardiologist-level performance; discusses deployment considerations and bias.

title: A prospective study of smartphone-based AF screening using photoplethysmography
abstract: In community screening, PPG-based irregular rhythm notifications had high specificity; confirmation with ECG was required to limit false positives.

title: Hydrogel-encapsulated pancreatic islets for long-term glycemic control in primates
abstract: Implantable hydrogel devices support islet survival and insulin secretion with reduced fibrosis; improved glycemic control demonstrated in nonhuman primates.

title: HIV-1 broadly neutralizing antibodies and vaccine design: lessons from clinical studies
abstract: Review summarizes bnAb trials, target epitopes, and sequential immunization strategies; addresses challenges in breadth, potency, and manufacturing.

title: A randomized trial of a digital therapeutic for insomnia in older adults
abstract: CBT-I delivered via app improved ISI scores and sleep efficiency versus education control; benefits maintained at 6 months with high adherence.

title: Clinical genome sequencing for precision medicine in pediatric rare disease: multicenter outcomes
abstract: Multicenter study reports diagnostic yield and changes in clinical management after rapid exome/genome sequencing in NICU and outpatient settings.

title: Global burden of antimicrobial resistance: a systematic analysis for 2019
abstract: Estimates deaths attributable to AMR by pathogen and syndrome; highlights gaps in surveillance and the importance of stewardship and infection prevention.
authors: Global Research on Antimicrobial Resistance (GRAM) Project
